105mm Dessert Bucket PP Cups: 400ml, 500ml & 700ml

Article Quick Facts

Catalog format
105mm Dessert Bucket PP
Listed capacities
400 / 500 / 700ml
Listed weights
47.5 / 48.5 / 53.5g
Carton quantity
400 pcs per model

Three 105mm Dessert Bucket Rows in the Catalog

The supplied injection PP catalog lists three 105mm Dessert Bucket models. They share the nominal caliber and 400-piece carton quantity, but capacity, catalog dimensions and weight change by model. Use the full row when planning samples, storage and the intended dessert or beverage application.

105mm Dessert Bucket PP Catalog Specifications

The values below reproduce the three supplied catalog rows. Request the final drawing to confirm dimension order, tolerances, rim profile and production revision before ordering.

Catalog modelFormatCapacityCatalog dimensionsWeightCarton
400 Dessert Bucket PPDessert Bucket PP400 ml105 × 85 × 79 mm47.5 g400 pcs

700 Dessert Bucket PPDessert Bucket PP700 ml105 × 127 × 81 mm53.5 g400 pcs

Compare Capacity, Height and Weight Together

The 400ml row lists 105 × 85 × 79mm and 47.5g; the 500ml row lists 105 × 109 × 77mm and 48.5g; and the 700ml row lists 105 × 127 × 81mm and 53.5g. These are catalog references for model selection, not approval of usable fill level, carrier fit or end-use performance.

What to Confirm Before Ordering

Copy the exact model, capacity, catalog dimensions, weight and 400-piece carton quantity into the supplier request. Ask for a final drawing and physical cup-and-closure sample. Rim-profile fit, lid or sealing-film compatibility, temperature rating, food-contact documents, printing, MOQ, price and lead time are 待工厂确认 for the selected model.

Article FAQs

Which capacities are listed for the 105mm Dessert Bucket PP series?

The catalog lists 400ml, 500ml and 700ml models.

Do all three 105mm models use the same carton quantity?

Yes. Each listed 105mm Dessert Bucket row shows 400 pieces per carton. Confirm the final packing configuration for the ordered version.

Which listed model is the lightest?

The 400ml row lists 47.5g, the 500ml row lists 48.5g and the 700ml row lists 53.5g. Confirm production tolerance with the factory.

Does the 105mm caliber guarantee a matching lid?

No. Nominal caliber alone does not establish rim-profile or closure compatibility. Test the selected cup and lid or sealing setup together.
